status: DONE -- D1 INCONCLUSIVE; D2 NOT_SUPPORTED (by the registered calibration rule). Holm-adjusted p 0.918 for both; nothing was significant before or after the correction. No follow-up variant (registered). Research-only, hypothesis-generating, directional track only; E034, direction_1h_v1, the live scoring and the move-size track untouched.
why: The 2026-10-17 signal inventory proposed two zero-cost directional comparisons on E032's machinery. D-1 asks whether the live system's four category scores carry ANY directional information beyond the four candle inputs E032 already uses -- a direct question about the BUY/HOLD/SELL engine's raw material. D-2 asks whether the strongest directional consistency the programme has found (E015's up_streak_6, mean next-hour return falling monotonically across all twelve streak levels) adds anything inside a fitted model.
duplicate_check: Not answered before. E032 compared its eight-input model M with the one-feature rule F (taker_buy_share_1h) and the base rate B; it never removed the four category scores as a group. E002 tested each category ALONE against forward returns (fit-free) and E011 used them only inside its sets. up_streak_6 was tested only fit-free and alone (E015: |rho| 0.080 / 0.060, below the 0.10 bar; an economic test at 0.4x the cost); it has never been inside a fitted model. E033 (power) and E034 (the prospective track) do not test either question.

hypotheses.D1: The four category scores (trend_score, momentum_score, volume_score, chart_pattern_score; scoring 0.2.0 replay) add directional information beyond the four candle inputs: Brier(R) - Brier(M) > 0, where R is M without them (inputs tr_mean_14_rel, trades_rel_168h, taker_buy_share_1h, taker_buy_share_6h).
hypotheses.D2: up_streak_6 adds directional information beyond the eight inputs: Brier(M) - Brier(C) > 0, where C is M plus up_streak_6 (agent/research/shape.py, unchanged; the signed run of same-direction closes capped at +/-6; it enters raw and is standardised by the model's per-fold scaler like every input; no other streak length, cap or threshold is tried).

target_and_horizon: E032's, unchanged: y = 1 if the 1 h return (close of the candle opening at as_of + 1 h vs the close at the cutoff) is > 0 (UP), else 0; build_frame target 'direction', horizon 1 h.
model: E032's, unchanged for M, R and C: L2 logistic regression C = 0.1 (LogisticModel; scaler fitted on each fold's training rows only), no calibration slice (E032 found the raw model calibrated). Baselines: B = each fold's training-range share of UP hours (BaseRateModel, leak-free); F = the same logistic on taker_buy_share_1h alone.

data.permitted: Development period only, through the governed readers (agent/research/snapshots.py): spot candles btcusdt_1h_2026-09-19.csv (68,868 development rows, sha256 8a87f7d4d2fea636c43479439c0ee7d99afd474ec6be805283892ab48fd35d63), trade counts and taker volume klines_extra_btcusdt_1h_2026-09-20.csv (68,868 development rows, sha256 04f0a2a0eed976cb5a683be8af8f79aee66a6681a9ee156448ff33c30dac7fa8), and the category-score replay data/replays/replay_btcusdt_1h_2026-09-19_2017082713_2025063023_p0.2.0_s0.2.0.csv (sha256 accf1a73d665e91bf04f2cb556d23d2de90197a269de128496f763e0c164c0fb), E032's.
data.boundaries: Reference hours up to 2025-06-30 22:00 UTC (the last whose outcome candle closes before the holdout). Exploration = before 2024-01-01; validation = 2024-01-01 -> 2025-06-30.
data.never: The sealed holdout (research/HOLDOUT_ACCESS.log must still not exist afterwards), the buffer, the live record, the prospective direction track's rows or outcomes (E034 is blind until its readings), any news score, any macro, derivatives or on-chain data, any download.

validation_design: E032's: expanding walk-forward, min_train 365 days, 90-day test blocks, purge 1 h + 24 h embargo, no calibration slice. Rows are restricted ONCE to hours where M's eight inputs, up_streak_6 and the label all exist; folds are built from that index; M, R, C, F and B are all scored on exactly those rows (R and F need fewer inputs but gain no rows). Expected: identical to E032's 56,309 out-of-sample rows (up_streak_6 is defined on every hour that has a candle); any difference is reported with its cause, and per-fold row counts are reported.

metrics.primary: Validation paired Brier differences: D1: d1 = Brier(R) - Brier(M); D2: d2 = Brier(M) - Brier(C) (positive = the hypothesis' direction).
metrics.secondary: Per period and model: Brier, skill vs the leak-free base rate (1 - Brier / Brier(B), E032's convention), log loss, ECE, E013's bucket rule, calibration intercept and slope, Spearman rho(p, 1 h return), accuracy at 0.5 next to the naive accuracy (never used alone to claim anything); each difference per calendar year 2018-2025; coefficient signs across folds; R and C also against F and B. Descriptive economics only, as in E032 (return edge, gross signed return per hour vs a 0.10% round trip); they decide nothing and claim no profitability.

uncertainty: Paired 48 h circular block bootstrap of each difference, 2,000 resamples, seed 31 (simple_baselines.paired_difference, E032's settings). Percentile intervals at 95% and 97.5%. Two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 * min((1 + #{d* <= 0}), (1 + #{d* >= 0})) / (1 + 2,000)) from the same resamples.
multiple_comparisons: The direction family of this batch has TWO comparisons (D1, D2): Holm at family-wise alpha = 0.05 (the smaller p against 0.025, then the other against 0.05); unadjusted and Holm-adjusted p are both reported. The move-size comparison (E036) is a separate family. Years and periods are descriptive only.
practical_threshold: E032's H_b bar, copied: the model WITH the extra information must reach at least 1.10 times the skill of the model without it, on the same rows (D1: skill(M) >= 1.10 * skill(R); D2: skill(C) >= 1.10 * skill(M)). In Brier terms: d >= 0.10 * skill(smaller model) * Brier(B), about 0.0001 at E032's validation values (0.10 * 0.0043 * 0.2499). (Should the smaller model's validation skill not be positive, S2 reads: the larger model's validation skill is positive.)
calibration_requirement: E032's H_c, copied: ECE <= 0.03 in both periods and E013's bucket rule on validation, for the model with the extra information (M in D1, C in D2); the other model's calibration is reported.

what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.SUPPORTED: All of: (S1) validation d > 0 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; (S2) d at or above the practical threshold; (S3) the exploration point estimate of d is also > 0; (S4) the calibration requirement holds; (S5) d > 0 in at least 6 of the 8 calendar years 2018-2025 (E032's H_d count). Meaning, D1: within E032's linear model at 1 h, the four category scores carry measurable extra directional information on development data. Meaning, D2: up_streak_6 adds measurable directional information beyond the eight inputs. Hypothesis-generating only; it authorises nothing: any prospective test would be a NEW, separately registered track with its own frozen artefact and storage, needing the user's approval (E033: such a comparison needs thousands of prospective hours, and a model-vs-model difference of this size may be undecidable prospectively). direction_1h_v1 and E034 are never changed.
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.NOT_SUPPORTED: The upper end of the validation 97.5% interval of d is below the practical threshold (the data exclude a practically useful gain), OR the model with the extra information fails the calibration requirement. Meaning, D1: in this linear 1 h model on development data, the four scoring-0.2.0 category scores add no practically useful directional information beyond the four candle inputs; it is NOT a statement that every underlying indicator is useless for every target. Meaning, D2: up_streak_6 adds no practically useful information to this model; the streak line is closed (no other length, cap or threshold).
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.INCONCLUSIVE: Anything else. Recorded as such; never converted into either answer; no follow-up variant.

tripwire: D2: a validation skill for C above 2 times M's (beyond what E015's strongest univariate association could plausibly add) stops the experiment before any verdict, and up_streak_6's point-in-time path is investigated first. D1: R scoring better than M by more than M's own skill vs the base rate (removing inputs cannot plausibly help that much) triggers the same check of the row alignment.

stop_rules: Stop a comparison if: E032 does not reproduce; a data boundary or timestamp cannot be verified; it needs data beyond the permitted files; M, R, C, F and B cannot be scored on identical rows; a test exposes a possible leak; a tripwire fires and is not explained; or the implementation deviates from this record. If one comparison becomes infeasible it alone stops; it is not replaced by another. A stopped or failed comparison is never re-run under a changed method as the same experiment.
validation_wear: About 35 experiments have examined these development periods, roughly ten of them directional (E011 and E032 fitted these very inputs on these rows). Whatever D1 and D2 find is HYPOTHESIS-GENERATING only.
expectation_stated_in_advance: D1: NOT_SUPPORTED or INCONCLUSIVE is likely (E002 found no positive information in any category; E032's eight-input model was not statistically better than one feature on validation, and R contains that feature). D2: INCONCLUSIVE is the most likely single outcome: up_streak_6 overlaps the reversal family already in M (momentum, taker-buy share), so a real but small gain below the practical bar is plausible.
compute_and_storage: Local only: E032's reproduction (three walk-forward runs), R and C on the common rows (M reused if the rows are identical), and the bootstraps; expected well under 15 minutes. Output under research/results/E037/ (JSON + markdown, < 5 MB). No network, no AI call, no database, no workflow, no new table, no paid service.
